This '''[[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droid]]''' participated in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] under command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]].

==Biography==
During the Battle of Mon Cala, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces as well as the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were defeated in the second assault on the [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari capital city]], and most of the city's inhabitants were imprisoned, along with the Republic forces sent to protect them, including [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].

Later on during the war, Mon Calamari prince [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] was also captured by the Separatists and was sentenced to public execution by commander Riff Tamson. This droid along with others helped transport Padmé Amidala and Jar Jar Binks to witness the execution of the prince. It is presumed that this droid was destroyed along with the rest of the Separatist forces when the Galactic Republic and Mon Calamari won the battle.
